text:
megan: quick heads up — pilot cohort 'Garnet' has ~18 accounts stuck in status awaiting_activation; onboarding events show up but playbook not firing. noticed jump after yesterday's tz ingestion fix.
raj: can you paste one account id and sample event timestamps?
megan: acct_8923 — last_event: 2024-05-04T02:12:07Z, state: awaiting_activation, last_playbook_run: 2024-05-03T23:58:01Z
olivia: hmm looks like event ingestion normalized to local tz then backfilled UTC; our playbook gating uses `last_event > last_playbook_run` which fails if times shift backward. :thinking:
sam: quick patch idea — flag accounts where last_event_ts < last_playbook_run_ts but event_count increased in last 72h. run this query and mark safe_for_rerun = true:
```
SELECT account_id FROM accounts a
JOIN events e ON e.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.state = 'awaiting_activation'
AND MAX(e.occurred_at) > a.last_event_ts
AND MAX(e.occurred_at) < a.last_playbook_run_ts + interval '72 hours'
GROUP BY a.account_id;
```
raj: can run now on staging, then a dry rerun of playbook on those ids.
megan: running staging query now — will post counts in 2m :hourglass:
playbook-bot: alert: playbook-run failed for playbook:onboard-activation x18 accounts (error: gating_mismatch) at 2024-05-04T03:10:12Z
megan: staging returned 19 ids, prod likely 18. ok to proceed with safe_for_rerun tag and manual rerun?
olivia: +1 from me. also file an item with infra to avoid tz-normalize race — suggest adding monotonic event_id fallback.
sam: i'll do the rerun and monitor success. if green, we can push a quick rule change to gating logic (use last_event_count delta + monotonic id). :shipit:
megan: thanks team. i'll update playbook-runbook and leave notes for CS on affected accounts and outreach template.
raj: ping me if any fails. I'll prep rollback plan.
megan: done — prod rerun kicked, 18/19 succeeded, one needs manual contact. tagging in CRM and creating follow-up threads. :white_check_mark:
